messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Q x 2-mixtures lognormal models and classifications
parts:
Sorry for not getting back to you sooner. This model looks OK to me.
We always recommend validating model coding by simulating data
and then using the model to recover the parameters.

You could vectorize the mu prior with

to_vector(mu) ~ normal(0, 10);

You can also use the log_mix() function built into Stan to do
binary mixtures.

log_mix(theta, lp1, lp2) = log_sum_exp(log(theta) + lp1,
log1m(theta) + lp2);

- Bob
